description: Search SkyBuyFly's price comparison of airport duty-free shops by product name, brand or category. Returns one card per product with its price at every airport shop that sells it (cheapest first, in the requested currency), its lowest price (an airport's or an online shop's), its product_id and a link to its SkyBuyFly page. Relevant when a traveller asks what something costs at airports, where it is cheapest, or whether an airport sells it. With airports (IATA codes) it returns only the products listed at every one of them, each card showing those airports' prices. Prices are the latest stored observations, each with its date; this tool does not check them live.

items.description: An airport's 3-letter IATA code, e.g. VIE.

airports.description: Up to 10 airport IATA codes, e.g. ['VIE', 'BER']: only products the catalogue lists at every one of these airports and with a current price at one of them at least; each card then shows the current prices at these airports only (an airport without a current price is left off the card). Leave it out, or pass [], to search every airport. list_airports has the airports SkyBuyFly compares.
airports.title: Airports

currency.description: A 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. EUR (any case; default USD), that every price is shown in; list_currencies has every one.
currency.title: Currency

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous answer, unchanged, to get the next page of the same search.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: How many products to return: a whole number from 1 to 20.
limit.title: Limit

query.description: 1-200 characters: what the traveller is looking for, a product name, brand, category or a mix of them, e.g. 'Chanel Coco Mademoiselle 100 ml', 'Lagavulin 16', 'sunscreen'.
query.title: Query

name: search_products

AirportPrice.description: A product's price at one airport, in the requested currency.
AirportPrice.title: AirportPrice

Money.description: An amount in an ISO 4217 currency, rounded to cents.
Money.title: Money

ProductCard.description:
One product with its price at every airport that sells it (cheapest first).

``lowest_price``/``highest_price`` span every comparable shop price, online shops included
(``lowest_price_scope`` says where the lowest is); ``airports`` lists airport prices only. ``offer_count`` is the
number of shop offers the API knows for the product (null where the answer does not say). ``size`` is the API's
own measure ("100 ml"; null where the answer carries none).
ProductCard.title: ProductCard

outputSchema.description: ``search_products`` (``notice``: set when tobacco or nicotine products were left out of this answer).
outputSchema.title: ProductListResult

title: Search duty-free prices
